message.content:
I don’t know what screens or buttons the new service should have—my job is about keeping drones and charging equipment running, not designing software. But I can tell you what the service needs to handle correctly:

- It must track which drones are at which sites and which charging pads are free.
- It needs to send drones to charge and take them out of service for repairs.
- It must handle unreliable instructions and reports from drones, especially when radio coverage is bad.
- It should let me see which drones are available for jobs and which are out of service.
